Q1_do_the_20_samples_carry_the_facts_the.answer: Cannot be verified from the artifact — and that is itself the finding, not a shrug. collect_herdr_lifecycle.py's collect() reduces each full sample (which DOES carry observation_time_source/process_facts_source/cleanup_source per herdr_runtime_observer.reduce_observation) down to a SHA256 digest only (sample_digests); the raw per-sample JSON is never written anywhere on disk. Confirmed by code read (both scripts) plus `find data/handoff/herdr-v3 data/handoff/herdr-v2 -type f` returning only plan.json + lifecycle-receipt.json in each directory — no raw-sample file exists to recompute a digest against.
Q1_do_the_20_samples_carry_the_facts_the.what_can_be_determined_independently: For herdr 0.8.0 specifically (the exact binary installed on this host, confirmed byte-identical to the frozen capture — see herdr_api_schema_reverify below), herdr-agent-surface.observed.json's own typed_substitutions/receipt_source_values_unreachable_against_captured_version tables prove observation_time_source can ONLY ever be OBSERVER_LOCAL_CLOCK and cleanup_source can ONLY ever be HERDR_PUBLISHED=false (i.e. OBSERVER_DERIVED or NOT_OBSERVED) at this herdr version — HERDR_SOURCE_CLOCK and cleanup_source=HERDR_PUBLISHED are both listed as unreachable. So first_source_observed_at_unix/last_source_observed_at_unix in this receipt are, with certainty derived from code + a live-reverified frozen contract (not from the receipt itself), the OBSERVER's own wall clock stamped at each poll — not any clock herdr published.
Q1_do_the_20_samples_carry_the_facts_the.is_that_a_forbidden_promotion_(observer_: NOT LITERALLY TRIGGERED — no field in the receipt asserts HERDR_SOURCE_CLOCK. But the receipt names the fields `first_source_observed_at_unix`/`last_source_observed_at_unix` without carrying the `observation_time_source` tag that would let a reader tell the difference, which is exactly the 'silently invented' shape the observer module's own prose warns against for typed substitutions. See SR-01.

Q2_is_cleanup_residue_content_bound_or_d.answer: Neither — cleanup/residue are ENTIRELY ABSENT from this receipt, and correctly so. final_observer_state is IDLE (nonterminal); herdr_runtime_observer._derive_cleanup is only invoked when mapped==DONE_CANDIDATE, and collect_herdr_lifecycle.validate_sequence only requires cleanup_state=CLEAN/residue_count=0 for TERMINAL samples. Confirmed by direct field enumeration of the receipt JSON (cross_checks.py): no cleanup/cleanup_state/residue_count/state/blockers key present at all. This is the correct, honest shape for a run that stopped at IDLE — not a gap.

findings.summary: collect_herdr_lifecycle.py and the shape-2 schema both silently drop the observation_time_source/process_facts_source/cleanup_source disclosure tags that herdr_runtime_observer.py was amended on 2026-08-22 to compute for exactly this purpose.
detail: herdr_runtime_observer.reduce_observation() returns these three tags per sample specifically so a reader can tell HERDR_PUBLISHED facts from OBSERVER_LOCAL/OBSERVER_DERIVED/OS_AUXILIARY substitutions (see herdr-agent-surface.observed.json's typed_substitutions table).

collect_herdr_lifecycle.collect()'s return dict (grep-confirmed: 0 matches for observation_time_source|process_facts_source|cleanup_source in that file) keeps only first_source_observed_at_unix/last_source_observed_at_unix/process_id/process_started_at_unix — the VALUES, not their provenance tags.

The schema's oneOf[1] branch has additionalProperties:false at the top level and defines no property named observation_time_source, process_facts_source or cleanup_source anywhere (grep-confirmed 0 matches) — so even a maximally honest collector could not add these fields back without a schema change.

Net effect: sample_digests (the only per-sample record retained) are opaque SHA256 hashes with no raw file backing them anywhere in the tree, so this specific, load-bearing disclosure is unrecoverable from the committed artifact, permanently, for this attempt.

findings.summary: agent_session_id is null throughout, and the plan never pins expected_agent_session_source, so this artifact cannot prove the 20 samples came from a herdr-managed agent rather than the `herdr pane report-agent` manual fallback.
detail: herdr-runtime-observer.md states explicitly: '(bind agent_session.source to reject manual reporters)'. herdr-plan.json's manifest has no expected_agent_session_source key, so reduce_observation() never asserted on it for this run.

IDLE (the state this run ends on) is in BOTH AgentStatus's real enum and report_agent_state_enum, so a manual reporter repeatedly invoking `herdr pane report-agent --state idle` would be indistinguishable from a real managed agent at this state, using only what survives in the final receipt.

Not resolved by process_id/process_started_at_unix being populated: those come from pane.process_info/ps, a separate herdr surface that reports the pane's real shell process regardless of whether the AGENT inside it is herdr-managed or manually reported.
findings.owner: issue 466 (next attempt should set expected_agent_session_source in herdr-plan.json before collecting)

findings.summary: The receipt's base_sha/tree_sha are unreachable from admitted main; they exist only on forensic/backup branches left over from a PR #599 commit-trailer-conformance rewrite, and the codex-v2 sibling receipt's own self-declared subject has the identical problem.
detail: git merge-base --is-ancestor 752b676d...HEAD exits 1. The commit is reachable only via backup-pre-trailer-fix / forensic/599-pre-trailer-fix.
Its same-message trailer-fixed twin 52dc788f (tree 2ccf85db, different from 752b676d's tree 5b957e10) is ALSO not an ancestor of HEAD.

data/handoff/codex-v2/issue-464-live-run-receipt.json self-declares subject.receipt_landing_commit=218a8240... and subject.queue_subject_commit=08a7d3c8... — both independently confirmed NOT ancestors of HEAD either.

No commit reachable from HEAD carries tree 5b957e10... or 2ccf85db... at all (grep over `git log HEAD --format=%H %T` is empty for both), so this is not a rename/no-op question: whatever the trailer-conformance rebuild finally landed on main has different bytes than what either forensic generation recorded.

Consequence for THIS item: the queue's own required_capability 'controller-source-diff-test-readback' cannot be run against admitted main using this base_sha as the anchor without first resolving which admitted commit (if any) actually supersedes it.
